note: The Mauritius Commercial Bank's statement of service charges for domestic operations under the Bank of Mauritius's template (last updated 7 October 2026): a personal current account's monthly service charge is 25 rupees plus VAT, written before tax, the statement giving no rate; its regular savings account has no monthly service charge.
